name: cr701_23_visibility_tutor_reveal
why: CR 701.23a / 701.20a / 701.20d: Personal Tutor's search is a look at the whole library by the searcher, ended by the shuffle; the found card is then revealed to all players until it moves to the top (step 1 T1 reveal windows, --trace-visibility)
expect_order: ^VISIBILITY: open look Ponder in library of A at 2 to A \(until resolution end\)
^VISIBILITY: close look Ponder in library of A at 2 to A \(shuffle\)
^VISIBILITY: open reveal Ponder in library of A at \d+ to all \(until resolution end\)
^VISIBILITY: close reveal Ponder in library of A at \d+ to all \(zone change\)
^Player A reveals Ponder and puts it to top of library
